lines.text: Flour rises in a beam of light.
@maya_front pulls a golden loaf from the oven.
She taps its base. It sounds hollow.
Steam curls off the crackling crust.
She breaks the loaf open. The crumb is soft and airy.
She lifts it to her face and breathes in.
A smile spreads as she sets it down to cool.

writes.note: I drafted a short bakery scene from your line, keeping the flour, the loaf and the tap.

reply.rationale: Expanded the single action line into a one-location 14 s visual scene, keeping @maya_front as written and avoiding any invented name or dialogue.
